name: Predisposition to Severe Viral Infection Due to IRF7 Deficiency

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic loss-of-function mutations in the IRF7 gene
History of life-threatening or severe viral infections, particularly influenza or other respiratory viruses
Demonstration of impaired type I interferon production or signaling in patient immune cells
Exclusion of other known primary immunodeficiencies or acquired immunosuppression

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biallelic IRF7 mutations plus history of severe viral infection and impaired type I interferon response
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Functional assays confirming IRF7 deficiency improve diagnostic confidence

pathognomonic.notes: Severe influenza pneumonia or acute respiratory distress syndrome

common.symptomName: Severe respiratory viral infections other than influenza
searchTerms: severe lung infections from viruses other than flu

common.notes: Extended duration of viral RNA detection
searchTerms: virus stays in body longer than usual

common.symptomName: Elevated serum inflammatory markers during infection
common.notes: Elevated CRP and ESR during acute viral illness
searchTerms: high inflammation blood markers during infection

occasional.symptomName: Fever of unknown origin during viral infections
searchTerms: fever without clear cause during viral illness

occasional.notes: Mild hepatitis during severe viral infections
searchTerms: elevated liver blood tests when sick

rare.symptomName: Neurological complications secondary to viral encephalitis
rare.notes: Rare cases of viral CNS involvement

rare.symptomName: Cutaneous viral infections with atypical severity
searchTerms: skin viral infections with unusual severity
immune system attacks self after infection

laboratory: Reduced or absent type I interferon production in response to viral stimuli
Elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ESR) during viral illness
imaging: CT scans revealing diffuse alveolar damage in severe cases
other: Functional assays demonstrating impaired IRF7-dependent interferon signaling

distinguishingFeatures: IRF9 deficiency involves impaired ISGF3 complex formation
Different genetic mutations and functional assay profiles
Broad immunodeficiency affecting multiple lymphocyte lineages
Early onset with bacterial and fungal infections in addition to viral

redFlags: Severe or life-threatening viral infection in early childhood
Poor or absent response to standard antiviral therapies
Family history of severe viral infections or consanguinity
references: Ciancanelli MJ, et al. Life-threatening influenza and impaired interferon amplification in human IRF7 deficiency. Science. 2015.
Hernandez N, et al. Inherited IRF7 deficiency in patients with life-threatening influenza. J Exp Med. 2018.
Orphanet: Predisposition to severe viral infection due to IRF7 deficiency. ORPHA:574918.
